SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY CDSCode
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside' AND ss.avg_math_score > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY CDSCode
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
WHERE ss.avg_math_score > 400 AND s.City = 'Riverside';

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside' AND ss.avg_math_score > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside' AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside' AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = REPLACE(st.cds, '0', '')
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside' AND st.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT frpm.School, AVG(frpm.AvgScrMath) AS AvgMathScore
    FROM frpm
    JOIN satscores ss ON frpm.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE frpm.City = 'Riverside'
    GROUP BY frpm.School
    HAVING AVG(frpm.AvgScrMath) > 400
) sub ON s.School = sub.School;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS AvgMathScore
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside' AND ss.AvgMathScore > 400;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.SchoolID = ss.SchoolID
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.SchoolID = ss.SchoolID
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.SchoolID = ss.SchoolID
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, f.`Charter Funding Type`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School Code
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, f.`Charter Funding Type`
HAVING AVG(f.`Charter Funding Type`) > 400;

SELECT s.School, f.`Charter Funding Type`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School Code
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, f.`Charter Funding Type`
HAVING AVG(f.`Charter Funding Type`) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(f.AvgScrMath) > 400;
